topics.title: Getting started: brainstorming and listing ideas

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how brainstorming or jotting ideas around a central topic helps a writer begin an essay.
Select relevant points from a random list and expand each into a sentence.
Recognise that an essay usually opens with a definition or short description of the topic.
Show how related points are grouped and developed into connected paragraphs.
Distinguish unity (all parts linked to the main subject) from coherence (logical sequence of ideas).
Apply relevance and proportion when choosing and weighting content in an essay.

topics.title: Model essay: The Importance of Games

concepts.learning_objective: Identify the physical benefits of games argued in the model essay.
Interpret the moral benefits and the dangers of games discussed in the essay.
Analyse the introduction-body-conclusion plan of the model essay paragraph by paragraph.
Plan an essay on a new topic by applying the steps shown in the chapter.
